campaign.goal: Find out whether they buy a car like this and at what rough price or next step.

openers.de: Guten Tag, <Name> möchte seinen <Auto> verkaufen, und ich rufe als sein KI-Assistent an. Haben Sie kurz Zeit?
openers.fr: Bonjour, <Name> souhaite vendre sa <Auto>, et j'appelle en tant que son assistant IA. Avez-vous un instant ?

campaign.ask: Then ask the one question: do they buy a car like this, rough price or next step? Ask them to reply by email to <address>.
campaign.contact_rule: Do not give any phone number unless this task includes one; the default is the email address above.
campaign.facts: <only facts that were already in the written outreach: model, VIN, plate, km, condition, known repairs>. Location only if asked.
campaign.rules: Do not speak while a recorded menu or message plays (press the sales key if offered); speak only to a live person; say the opener once, then wait; one short sentence per turn; hang up right after any goodbye; answer 'are you still there' once at most; 5-minute limit; if nobody answers leave one short voicemail and hang up; if the line dies instantly do not retry on this call.
